problems.problem: The declared 'narrow sans title wrapped over two lines' is still not achieved: current title bbox is [59,620,352,652], a single 32px-tall line 293px wide, because size 44 with tracking 2 measures under the 300px max_width so no wrap occurs. Against a 545px-wide, 720px-tall gown the type mass is under-scaled (title cap height ~32px vs 720px subject), and the whole column (title y620-652, rule y700, subtitle y745-766) stops at y766, leaving the lower-left two-thirds of the sheet as empty ink-less field. References (Claudie, Monsoon) set type at a scale that holds the sheet; here the column reads as a small label floating beside a dominant cutout.

The aqua bar's lower segment is degraded by the ellipse overprint: between the hem (y~1080) and the bar's end (y1239) the #7FD8E8 rectangle sits under the 0.85-opacity #0A2E35 ellipse and renders as a dull grey-teal stub (visible in the contact crop at crop x~470-530, y~130-250, i.e. poster x~853-912, y~1070-1190). The bar therefore reads as two disconnected pieces - bright aqua above the hem, muddy stub below - instead of one continuous column, and the stub terminates in dead air at y1239 without aligning to the ellipse edge or the canvas margin.

Diagonal weight still sits in one corner: the ellipse bbox [640,960,1200,1520] crosses the right and bottom edges and fills the lower-right quadrant, while the lower-left quadrant (x0-450, y770-1440) carries no ink at all. The hem meets the ellipse arc at a shallow tangent (contact crop shows the royal-blue ruffle edge kissing the arc around crop x~300-450, y~120-160) so the layering reads as near-collision rather than a framed overlap; shifting the ellipse so its arc passes clearly behind the hem's center mass would convert the tangent into deliberate framing.
